label: Demonstrability from mere ideas: The ability to refute the uncaused-beginning description by…
definition: The ability to refute the uncaused-beginning description by reasoning from ideas alone is represented by the explicit refutes parameter. NarrowWithholding denies that refutation, without denying a cause or asserting metaphysical realizability.
note: Issue #248 analytical vocabulary, scoped to this test. A source endorsement would require a separate passage-specific claim; the existing I.3.3 claim supplies only the narrow reading.
